newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil reverses earlier trend, ends down.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil reverses earlier trend, ends down.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Lack of follow-through support and profit-taking erased morning gains and prices closed lower in volatile trade. Earlier gains were boosted by firmer project A soyoil prices. More selling emerged as July futures failed to hit the 1,300 high. Outlook for near-term is range bound and July futures will trade between 1,280 and 1,300.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Also trended lower in scattered deals.
At the close, the July futures contract was five ringgit down at 1,285 ringgit ($512.77) a tonne after trading in a 13-ringgit range.

"July contract couldn't break the 1,300 ringgit and people started taking profits," a trader said, adding that the market was cautious in the absence of fresh developments and ahead of a crop report by private forecaster Ivan Wong at mid-week.
"Since it (July futures) could touch the 1,300 level, we felt that July futures would continue to be rangebound," a trader added. "The contract will trade between 1,280 and 1,300 level."

News that Egypt will seek 4,000 to 5,000 tonnes of crude palm kernel oil or coconut oil for June delivery on May 20 had no impact on the market which still lacked interest from traditional palm oil buyers, traders said.
Trading was volatile and turnover was 2,220 lots.

Physicals May (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,365 vs bids of 1,360 after trading from 1,370 to 1,365. May (central) saw offers at 1,352.50 vs bids of 1,347.50 with earlier trades done at 1,350 and 1,347.50.
June (south) was offered at 1,350 vs bids at 1,342.50 with earlier trades done at 1,347.50 and 1,345.
June (central) saw offers at 1,335 versus bids at 1,325.
In refined products, May RBD palm oil was offered at $572.50, June at $562.50 and July/Aug/Sept at $552.50.
May RBD palm olein saw offers at $610, June at $600, July at $590 and July/Aug/Sept at $590. July was traded at $587.50.
May RBD palm stearin was offered at $435, June at $430 and May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $290.
